entries.6.1: तैः by them, वध्यमानाः being assailed, देवाः the gods, ऋषयः च and the sages, तपोधनाः rich in penance, भयार्ताः tormented by fear, देवदेवम् the god of gods, महेश्वरम् Maheshvara, शरणम् for refuge, जग्मुः went
entries.6.2: जगत्सृष्ट्यन्तकर्तारम् the maker of the world's creation and its ending, अजम् the unborn, अव्यक्तरूपिणम् whose form is unmanifest, सर्वलोकानाम् of all the worlds, आधारम् the support, आराध्यम् to be worshipped, परमम् गुरुम् the supreme teacher
entries.6.3: ते देवाः those gods, कामारिम् the foe of Kama, त्रिपुरारिम् the destroyer of the three cities, त्रिलोचनम् the three eyed one, समेत्य तु having come to, प्राञ्जलयः with joined palms, भयगद्गदभाषिणः their voices faltering with fear, ऊचुः spoke
entries.6.4: भगवन् lord, प्रजाध्यक्ष overseer of creatures, रिपुबाधनैः who afflict as enemies, पितामहवरोद्धतैः made insolent by the Grandsire's boon, सुकेशपुत्रैः by the sons of Sukesha, सर्वाः प्रजाः all beings, बाध्यन्ते are oppressed
entries.6.5: नः our, शरण्यानि places of refuge, आश्रमाणि the hermitages, अशरण्यानि हि no refuge at all, कृतानि have been made, स्वर्गात् from heaven, देवान् the gods, प्रच्याव्य च having cast out, स्वर्गे in heaven, देववत् as gods, क्रीडन्ति they sport
entries.6.6: अहम् I, विष्णुः am Vishnu, अहम् I, रुद्रः am Rudra, अहम् I, ब्रह्मा am Brahma, अहम् I, देवराट् am the king of the gods, अहम् I, यमः am Yama, वरुणः च and Varuna, अहम् I, चन्द्रः am the moon, अहम् अपि and I, रविः am the sun
entries.6.7: इति thus, माली Mali, सुमाली च and Sumali, माल्यवान् च एव and Malyavan, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, समरोद्धर्षाः exulting in battle, बाधन्ते harass us, ये च and those who, तेषाम् of them, पुरःसराः go before, तत् therefore, देव god, भयार्तानाम् नः to us who are afflicted with fear, अभयम् safety, दातुम् to give, अर्हसि you should
entries.6.8: अशिवम् terrible, वपुः a form, आस्थाय having taken on, देवकण्टकान् those thorns in the side of the gods, जहि वै destroy
entries.6.9: इति thus, सर्वैः सुरैः by all the gods, उक्तः being addressed, कपर्दी the lord of the matted hair, नीललोहितः dark and red, सुकेशम् प्रति toward Sukesha, सापेक्षः having still some regard, प्रभुः the lord, देवगणान् to the hosts of gods, प्राह said
entries.6.10: सुराः gods, अहम् I, तान् them, न हनिष्यामि shall not slay, ते they, मया by me, अवध्याः हि may not be slain, किम् तु but, मन्त्रम् counsel, प्रदास्यामि I shall give, यः by which, तान् them, वै indeed, निहनिष्यति will destroy
entries.6.11: महर्षयः great sages, एतम् एव समुद्योगम् this very endeavour, पुरस्कृत्य having taken up, विष्णुम् to Vishnu, शरणम् for refuge, गच्छध्वम् go, सः प्रभुः that lord, तान् them, हनिष्यति will slay
entries.6.12: ततः तु then, महेश्वरम् Maheshvara, जयशब्देन with cries of victory, प्रतिनन्द्य having greeted, निशाचरभयार्दिताः tormented by fear of the night rangers, विष्णोः of Vishnu, समीपम् into the presence, आजग्मुः came
entries.6.13: शङ्खचक्रधरम् who bears the conch and the discus, देवम् the god, प्रणम्य having bowed, बहुमान्य च and having greatly honoured, सुकेशतनयान् प्रति concerning the sons of Sukesha, सम्भ्रान्तवत् in agitation, वाक्यम् a word, ऊचुः spoke
entries.6.14: देव god, त्रेताग्निसन्निभैः like the threefold sacrificial fire, त्रिभिः by the three, सुकेशतनयैः sons of Sukesha, वरदानेन by the granting of a boon, आक्रम्य having overrun, नः our, स्थानानि stations, अपहृतानि have been taken away
entries.6.15: लङ्का नाम named Lanka, दुर्गा hard to assail, पुरी a city, त्रिकूटशिखरे upon the peak of Trikuta, स्थिता stands, तत्र there, स्थिताः established, क्षणदाचराः those night rangers, सर्वान् नः all of us, प्रबाधन्ते oppress
entries.6.16: मधुसूदन slayer of Madhu, सः त्वम् you, अस्मद्धितार्थाय for our good, तान् them, जहि destroy, वयम् we, त्वाम् to you, शरणम् for refuge, प्राप्ताः have come, सुरेश्वर lord of the gods, गतिः our recourse, भव be
entries.6.17: चक्रकृत्तास्यकमलान् their lotus faces severed by your discus, यमाय to Yama, वै indeed, निवेदय send, भयेषु in our fears, अस्माकम् to us, अभयदः a giver of safety, भवता विना but you, अन्यः another, न अस्ति there is not
entries.6.18: देव god, समरे in battle, दुष्टान् wicked, सानुबन्धान् with all who follow them, मदोद्धतान् insolent with pride, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, नः our, भयम् fear, भास्करः the sun, नीहारम् इव as the mist, त्वम् you, नुद dispel
entries.6.19: इति एवम् thus, दैवतैः by the gods, उक्तः being addressed, देवदेवः the god of gods, जनार्दनः Janardana, अरीणाम् to his enemies, भयदः who gives fear, अभयम् safety, दत्त्वा having granted, देवान् to the gods, उवाच ह said
entries.6.20: ईशानवरदर्पितम् made proud by Ishana's boon, सुकेशम् Sukesha, राक्षसम् the rakshasa, जाने I know, अस्य his, तान् तनयान् च and those sons, जाने I know, येषाम् of whom, सः माल्यवान् that Malyavan, ज्येष्ठः is the eldest
entries.6.21: समतिक्रान्तमर्यादान् who have overstepped all bounds, तान् राक्षसाधमान् those lowest of rakshasas, अहम् I, सङ्क्रुद्धः in my wrath, निहनिष्यामि shall destroy, सुराः gods, विज्वराः free of fever, भवत be
entries.6.22: इति thus, प्रभविष्णुना by the mighty, विष्णुना by Vishnu, उक्ताः being addressed, ते सर्वे सुराः all those gods, हृष्टाः glad, जनार्दनम् Janardana, प्रशंसन्तः praising, यथावासम् each to his dwelling, ययुः went
entries.6.23: माल्यवान् तु but Malyavan, निशाचरः the night ranger, विबुधानाम् of the gods, समुद्योगम् the endeavour, श्रुत्वा having heard, तौ वीरौ भ्रातरौ to those two brave brothers, इदम् वचनम् this word, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.6.24: अमराः the immortals, ऋषयः च एव and the sages, किल it seems, शङ्करम् Shankara, सङ्गम्य having gone together to, अस्मद्वधम् our destruction, परीप्सन्तः seeking, इदम् वचनम् these words, अब्रुवन् spoke
entries.6.25: देव god, वरदानबलोद्धताः made insolent by the power of a boon, समुद्दृप्ताः arrogant, घोररूपाः dreadful of form, सुकेशतनयाः the sons of Sukesha, पदे पदे at every step, अस्मान् us, बाधन्ते oppress
entries.6.26: प्रजापते lord of creatures, राक्षसैः by the rakshasas, अभिभूताः स्म we are overcome, तेषाम् दुरात्मनाम् of those evil souled ones, भयात् for fear, स्वेषु सद्मसु in our own dwellings, संस्थातुम् to remain, न शक्ताः स्म we are not able
entries.6.27: त्रिलोचन three eyed one, तत् therefore, अस्माकम् our, हितार्थाय for the good, तान् them, जहि destroy, प्रदहताम् वर best of those who burn, हुङ्कृतेन एव with a mere sound of your anger, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, दह burn
entries.6.28: इति एवम् thus, त्रिदशैः by the thirty, उक्तः being addressed, निशम्य having heard, अन्धकसूदनः the slayer of Andhaka, शिरः his head, करम् च and his hand, धुन्वानः shaking, इदम् वचनम् this word, अब्रवीत् said
entries.6.29: देवाः gods, ते सुकेशतनयाः those sons of Sukesha, रणे in battle, मम by me, अवध्याः may not be slain, मन्त्रम् तु but counsel, वः to you, प्रदास्यामि I shall give, यः by which, तान् them, वै indeed, निहनिष्यति will destroy
entries.6.30: यः असौ he who, चक्रगदापाणिः bears the discus and the mace in his hands, पीतवासाः clothed in yellow, जनार्दनः Janardana, हरिः Hari, श्रीमान् the glorious, नारायणः Narayana, तम् him, शरणम् for refuge, प्रपद्यथ go to
entries.6.31: ते they, हरात् from Hara, तम् मन्त्रम् that counsel, अवाप्य having received, कामारिम् the foe of Kama, अभिवाद्य च and having saluted, नारायणालयम् Narayana's abode, प्राप्य having reached, तस्मै to him, सर्वम् all of it, न्यवेदयन् laid before him
entries.6.32: ततः then, इन्द्रपुरोगमाः with Indra at their head, देवाः the gods, नारायणेन by Narayana, उक्ताः were told, तान् those, सुरारीन् enemies of the gods, हनिष्यामि I shall slay, सुराः gods, विज्वराः free of fever, भवत be
entries.6.33: राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among rakshasas, भयभीतानाम् who fear us, देवानाम् to the gods, हरिणा by Hari, अस्माकम् our, वधः destruction, प्रतिज्ञातः has been promised, इह here, यत् क्षमम् what is fitting, चिन्त्यताम् let it be considered
entries.6.34: हिरण्यकशिपोः of Hiranyakashipu, अन्येषाम् च and of the other, सुरद्विषाम् haters of the gods, मृत्युः the death, नमुचिः Namuchi, कालनेमिः च and Kalanemi, वीरसत्तमः best among heroes, संह्रादः Samhrada
entries.6.35: बहुमायी of many wiles, राधेयः च and Radheya, धार्मिकः the righteous, लोकपालः अथ and guardian of the world, यमलार्जुनौ च and the twin Arjunas, हार्दिक्यः Hardikya, शुम्भः च एव and Shumbha, निशुम्भकः and Nishumbha
entries.6.36: असुराः asuras, दानवाः च एव and danavas, सत्त्ववन्तः of great courage, महाबलाः of great might, सर्वे all of them, समरम् battle, आसाद्य having met, अपराजिताः unconquered, न श्रूयन्ते are not heard of
entries.6.37: सर्वैः by all, क्रतुशतैः with a hundred sacrifices, इष्टम् was sacrificed, तथा and, सर्वे all, मायाविदः knew the arts of illusion, सर्वे all, सर्वास्त्रकुशलाः skilled in every weapon, सर्वे all, शत्रुभयङ्कराः struck terror into their foes
entries.6.38: नारायणेन by Narayana, शतशः by hundreds, अथ and, सहस्रशः by thousands, निहताः were slain, एतत् this, ज्ञात्वा तु having known, इह here, सर्वेषाम् for us all, क्षमम् what is fitting, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ you should
entries.6.39: ततः then, सुमाली Sumali, माली च and Mali, माल्यवतः of Malyavan, वचः the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वासवम् to Vasava, भगांशौ इव as Bhaga and Amsha, ज्येष्ठम् भ्रातरम् to their eldest brother, ऊचतुः spoke
entries.6.40: स्वधीतम् we have studied, दत्तम् we have given, इष्टम् च and sacrificed, ऐश्वर्यम् our lordship, परिपालितम् has been preserved, निरामयम् free of sickness, आयुः life, प्राप्तम् has been obtained, पथि upon the path, सुधर्मः good order, प्रापितः has been set
entries.6.41: अक्षोभ्यम् unshakeable, देवसागरम् the ocean of the gods, शस्त्रैः with our weapons, समवगाह्य च having plunged into, अप्रतिमाः हि who had no match, द्विषः foes, जिताः were conquered, तत् नः this fear of ours, मृत्युकृतम् death's own work, भयम् fear
entries.6.42: नारायणः च Narayana, रुद्रः च and Rudra, शक्रः च अपि and Shakra too, तथा and likewise, यमः Yama, सर्वे all of them, सर्वदा always, अस्माकम् our, प्रमुखे before us, स्थातुम् to stand, बिभ्यति fear
entries.6.43: राक्षसेश्वर lord of rakshasas, विष्णोः देवस्य in the god Vishnu, कारणम् cause, न अस्ति एव there is none at all, देवानाम् एव of the gods alone, दोषेण by the fault, विष्णोः of Vishnu, मनः the mind, प्रचलितम् has been turned
entries.6.44: तस्मात् therefore, अद्य today, समुद्युक्ताः made ready, सर्वसैन्यसमावृताः surrounded by all our forces, देवान् एव the gods themselves, जिघांसामः let us seek to slay, एभ्यः from them, दोषः this trouble, समुत्थितः has arisen
entries.6.45: एवम् thus, सम्मन्त्र्य having taken counsel, बलिनः those mighty ones, सर्वे all, सैन्यसमावृताः surrounded by their armies, उद्योगम् the endeavour, घोषयित्वा तु having proclaimed, सर्वे नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवाः all those bulls among the nairritas, क्रुद्धाः in wrath, जम्भवृत्रबलाः इव with the strength of Jambha and Vritra, युद्धाय to battle, निर्ययुः marched out
entries.6.46: राम Rama, इति thus, ते राक्षसाः those rakshasas, सम्मन्त्र्य having taken counsel, महाकायाः of great bulk, महाबलाः of great strength, सर्वे all, सर्वोद्योगेन with their whole array, युद्धाय to battle, निर्ययुः marched out
entries.6.47: स्यन्दनैः with chariots, वारणैः च एव and with elephants, गिरिसन्निभैः like mountains, हयैः च and with horses, खरैः with asses, गोभिः with cattle, रथोष्ट्रैः च and with camel drawn cars, शिंशुमारैः with porpoises, भुजङ्गमैः with serpents
entries.6.48: मकरैः with sea monsters, कच्छपैः with tortoises, मीनैः with fishes, गरुडोपमैः विहङ्गैः with birds like Garuda, सिंहैः with lions, व्याघ्रैः with tigers, वराहैः च and with boars, सृमरैः with wild oxen, चमरैः अपि and with yaks
entries.6.49: लङ्काम् Lanka, त्यक्त्वा having left, बलगर्विताः proud of their strength, सर्वे राक्षसाः all those rakshasas, गताः went, दैवतशत्रवः those enemies of the gods, योद्धुम् to give battle, देवलोकाय toward the world of the gods, प्रयाताः set out
entries.6.50: लङ्काविपर्ययम् that reversal in Lanka, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अथ then, यानि लङ्कालयानि those which dwelt in Lanka, भूतानि beings, भयदर्शीनि fearful to look upon, सर्वशः in every way, विमनस्कानि were troubled in mind
entries.6.51: रथोत्तमैः in their excellent chariots, शतशः by hundreds, अथ and, सहस्रशः by thousands, उह्यमानाः borne
entries.6.52: राक्षसाः the rakshasas, तूर्णम् swiftly, प्रयत्नतः with effort, देवलोकम् to the world of the gods, प्रयाताः went, रक्षसाम् एव of the rakshasas, मार्गेण by the very road, दैवतानि the gods, अपचक्रमुः withdrew
entries.6.53: भौमाः upon the earth, च एव and, अन्तरिक्षाः in the sky, कालाज्ञप्ताः commanded by Kala, भयावहाः dreadful, उत्पाताः portents, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् for the lords of rakshasas, अभावाय for their destruction, समुत्थिताः arose
entries.6.54: मेघाः the clouds, अस्थीनि bones, ववृषुः rained, उष्णम् hot, शोणितम् एव च and blood, समुद्राः the oceans, वेलाम् their shores, उत्क्रान्ताः च overpassed, भूधराः च अपि and the mountains, चेलुः shook
entries.6.55: घननादसमस्वनाः with a sound like thunder, अट्टहासान् loud laughter, विमुञ्चन्तः uttering, दारुणम् dreadful, घोरदर्शनाः terrible to behold, शिवाः jackals, तत्र there, वाश्यन्ति च howled
entries.6.56: अथ then, भूतानि creatures, सम्पतन्ति fall, यथाक्रमम् one after another, दृश्यन्ते च and appear, अत्र here, ज्वलनोद्गारिभिः मुखैः with fire pouring from their mouths, महत् great, गृध्रचक्रम् च and a wheel of vultures
entries.6.57: राक्षसानाम् उपरि above the rakshasas, खे in the sky, अलातचक्रवत् like a whirling firebrand, भ्रमते circled, रक्तपादाः red footed, कपोताः pigeons, शारिकाः च and mynahs, विद्रुताः fled, ययुः went, तत्र एव there itself, काकाः crows, वाश्यन्ति croaked, बिडालाः cats, द्विपादयः वै and other beasts
entries.6.58: बलगर्विताः proud of their strength, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, तान् उत्पातान् those portents, अनादृत्य disregarding, मृत्युपाशावपाशिताः bound in the noose of death, यान्ति एव went on, न निवर्तन्ते and did not turn back
entries.6.59: माल्यवान् च Malyavan, सुमाली च and Sumali, माली च and Mali, सुमहाबलाः of great might, तेषाम् of them, क्रतूनाम् of the sacrifices, पावकाः इव as the fires, पुरःसराः went before, आसन् they were
entries.6.60: ते सर्वे निशाचराः all those night rangers, माल्यवन्तम् Malyavan, अचलम् an unmoving mountain, माल्यवन्तम् इव as the Malyavan, देवताः the gods, धातारम् इव as the Creator, आश्रयन्ति हि took refuge in
entries.6.61: महाभ्रघननादितम् thundering like great clouds, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् of the lords of rakshasas, तत् बलम् that host, मालिवशे under Mali's command, स्थितम् standing, जयेप्सया desiring victory, देवलोकम् to the world of the gods, ययौ went
entries.6.62: प्रभुः the lord, सः नारायणः that Narayana, राक्षसानाम् of the rakshasas, तम् समुद्योगम् that endeavour, देवदूतात् from a messenger of the gods, उपश्रुत्य having heard, तदा then, युद्धे upon battle, मनः his mind, चक्रे set
entries.6.63: सः he, सज्जायुधतूणीरः his weapons and quivers made ready, वैनतेयोपरि upon the son of Vinata, स्थितः seated, सहस्रार्कसमद्युति bright as a thousand suns, दिव्यम् divine, कवचम् armour, आसज्ज्य having fastened on
entries.6.64: तदा then, शरसम्पूर्णे full of arrows, विमले spotless, इषुधी the two quivers, श्रोणिसूत्रम् च and his girdle, विमलम् spotless, खड्गम् च and his sword, आबध्य having bound on, कमलेक्षणः the lotus eyed one, शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गखड्गाख्यप्रवरायुधान् his foremost weapons named conch and discus and mace and Sharnga and sword
entries.6.65: अथ then, गिरिसङ्काशम् huge as a mountain, सुपर्णम् Suparna, वैनतेयम् the son of Vinata, आस्थितः mounted upon, प्रभुः the lord, राक्षसानाम् of the rakshasas, अभावाय for the destruction, तूर्णतरम् with all speed, ययौ went
entries.6.66: सः हरिः that Hari, श्यामः dark, पीताम्बरः clothed in yellow, सुपर्णपृष्ठे upon Suparna's back, काञ्चनस्य गिरेः of a golden mountain, शृङ्गे upon the peak, सतडित्तोयदः यथा as a rain cloud with lightning, बभौ shone
entries.6.67: सः he, सिद्धदेवर्षिमहोरगैः च by siddhas and divine sages and great serpents, गन्धर्वयक्षैः by gandharvas and yakshas, उपगीयमानः being sung, चक्रासिशार्ङ्गायुधशङ्खपाणिः bearing discus and sword and Sharnga and conch in his hands, असुरसैन्यशत्रून् those enemies who were the army of the asuras, समाससाद came upon
entries.6.68: सुपर्णपक्षानिलनुन्नपक्षम् its flanks driven back by the wind of Suparna's wings, भ्रमत्पताकम् its banners whirling, प्रविकीर्णशस्त्रम् its weapons scattered, तत् राक्षसराजसैन्यम् that army of the rakshasa king, चलोपलम् its rocks loosened, नीलः अचलेन्द्रः इव as a dark lord of mountains, चचाल shook
entries.6.69: ततः then, निशाचराः the night rangers, माधवम् Madhava, सम्परिवार्य having surrounded, शोणितमांसरूषितैः smeared with blood and flesh, युगान्तवैश्वानरतुल्यविग्रहैः whose forms were like the fire at the ending of an age, शरैः with arrows, वरायुधैः with their finest weapons, सहस्रशः by thousands, निर्बिभिदुः pierced him
entries.7.1: ते तु they, गर्जन्तः roaring, राक्षसाम्बुदाः the rakshasas who were clouds, नारायणगिरिम् Narayana the mountain, अम्बुदाः as clouds, अद्रिम् a mountain, वर्षेण इव with their rain, शरवर्षेण with a rain of arrows, ववर्षुः rained upon
entries.7.2: श्यामावदातः dark and radiant, विष्णुः Vishnu, नीलैः dark, तैः नक्तञ्चरोत्तमैः by those chieftains of the night rangers, वृतः encircled, वर्षमाणैः raining, पयोधरैः by clouds, अञ्जनगिरिः इव like the collyrium mountain, आसीत् was
entries.7.3: शलभाः locusts, केदारम् इव as upon a field, मशकाः gnats, पर्वतम् इव as upon a mountain, दंशाः flies, अमृतघटम् यथा as upon a jar of nectar, मकराः sea monsters, अर्णवम् च इव and as upon the ocean
entries.7.4: तथा so, रक्षोधनुर्मुक्ताः loosed from the bows of the rakshasas, वज्रानिलमनोजवाः swift as the thunderbolt and the wind and thought, शराः the arrows, विपर्यये at the dissolution, लोकाः इव as the worlds, हरिम् Hari, विशन्ति स्म entered
entries.7.5: स्यन्दनगताः those on chariots, स्यन्दनैः with their chariots, गजपृष्ठगाः those on elephants' backs, गजैः च and with their elephants, अश्वारोहाः the horsemen, तथा and, अश्वैः with their horses, पादाताः च and the foot soldiers, अम्बरे in the sky, स्थिताः standing
entries.7.6: गिरिनिभाः huge as mountains, राक्षसेन्द्राः the lords of rakshasas, शरैः with arrows, शक्त्यृष्टितोमरैः with spears and lances and javelins, हरिम् Hari, प्राणायामाः the breathing exercises, द्विजम् इव as a brahmin, निरुच्छ्वासम् without breath, चक्रुः made
entries.7.7: निशाचरैः by the night rangers, महोदधिः the great ocean, मीनैः इव as by its fishes, ताड्यमानः being struck, दुर्धर्षः the unassailable one, शार्ङ्गम् the Sharnga bow, आयम्य having drawn, राक्षसेभ्यः against the rakshasas, शरान् arrows, असृजत् loosed
entries.7.8: विष्णुः Vishnu, पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः drawn to the full and released, वज्रवक्त्रैः thunder mouthed, मनोजवैः swift as thought, निशितैः sharp, शरैः with arrows, शतशः by hundreds, अथ and, सहस्रशः by thousands, चिच्छेद cut them down
entries.7.9: वर्षा the rains, वायुः the wind, उत्थितम् इव as what has risen, शरवर्षेण with a rain of arrows, विद्राव्य having scattered them, पुरुषोत्तमः the best of beings, महाशङ्खम् the great conch, पाञ्चजन्यम् Panchajanya, प्रदध्मौ blew
entries.7.10: सः शङ्खराट् that king of conches, अम्बुजः born of the waters, हरिणा by Hari, सर्वप्राणेन with all his breath, ध्मातः blown, भीमनिर्हादः with a terrible sound, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, व्यथयन् इव as though shaking, ररास roared
entries.7.11: अथ then, सः शङ्खराजरवः that sound of the king of conches, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, मृगराजः the lion, अरण्ये in the forest, समदान् rutting, कुञ्जरान् इव as elephants, त्रासयामास terrified
entries.7.12: अश्वाः the horses, संस्थातुम् to keep their footing, न शेकुः were not able, कुञ्जराः the elephants, विमदाः lost their rut, अभवन् became, शङ्खरावितदुर्बलाः weakened by the roar of the conch, वीराः heroes, स्यन्दनेभ्यः from their chariots, च्युताः fell
entries.7.13: शार्ङ्गचापविनिर्मुक्ताः loosed from the Sharnga bow, वज्रतुल्याननाः with faces like the thunderbolt, सुपुङ्खाः finely feathered, शराः the arrows, तानि रक्षांसि those rakshasas, विदार्य having torn through, क्षितिम् the earth, विविशुः entered
entries.7.14: सङ्ख्ये in battle, नारायणकरच्युतैः loosed from Narayana's hand, शरैः by arrows, भिद्यमानाः being pierced, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, वज्रहताः struck by the thunderbolt, शैलाः इव as mountains, भूमौ upon the ground, निपेतुः fell
entries.7.15: विष्णुचक्रकृतानि made by Vishnu's discus, परगात्रेभ्यः from the enemies' limbs, व्रणानि वै the wounds, धाराभिः in streams, असृक् blood, क्षरन्ति pour, स्वर्णधाराः streams of gold, अचलाः इव as mountains
entries.7.16: शङ्खराजरवः च the sound of the king of conches, तथा and, शार्ङ्गचापरवः the sound of the Sharnga bow, राक्षसानाम् of the rakshasas, रवान् च अपि and the cries too, वैष्णवः रवः the roar of Vishnu, ग्रसते swallows
entries.7.17: सः हरिः that Hari, शरैः with his arrows, तेषाम् their, धूतान् shaken, शिरोधरान् necks, शरध्वजधनूंषि च and shafts and banners and bows, रथान् chariots, पताकाः flags, तूणीरान् quivers, चिच्छेद cut down
entries.7.18: सूर्यात् from the sun, घोराः fierce, कराः इव as the rays, सागरात् from the sea, ऊर्मयः इव as the waves, पर्वतात् from a mountain, नागेन्द्राः इव as great serpents, अम्बुदात् from a cloud, धारौघाः इव च and as torrents of rain
entries.7.19: तथा so, शार्ङ्गविनिर्मुक्ताः loosed from the Sharnga, नारायणेरिताः sped by Narayana, शराः the arrows, इषवः shafts, तूर्णम् swiftly, शतशः by hundreds, अथ and, सहस्रशः by thousands, निर्धावन्ति fly forth
entries.7.20: सिंहाः lions, शरभेण by the sharabha, यथा as, द्विरदाः elephants, सिंहेन by the lion, यथा as, व्याघ्राः tigers, द्विरदेन by the elephant, यथा as, द्वीपिनः leopards, व्याघ्रेण by the tiger, यथा as
entries.7.21: श्वानः dogs, द्वीपिना by the leopard, यथा as, मार्जारकाः cats, शुना by the dog, यथा as, सर्पाः snakes, मार्जारेण by the cat, यथा as, आखवः mice, सर्पेण च and by the snake, यथा as
entries.7.22: तथा so, ते सर्वे राक्षसाः all those rakshasas, प्रभविष्णुना by the mighty, विष्णुना by Vishnu, द्रवन्ति fled, अन्ये others, द्राविताः were put to flight, महीतले upon the earth, शायिताः च and were laid low
entries.7.23: मधुसूदनः the slayer of Madhu, राक्षसानाम् of the rakshasas, सहस्राणि thousands, निहत्य having slain, सुरराट् the king of the gods, तोयदम् इव as a cloud, वारिजम् the conch born of the waters, पूरयामास filled
entries.7.24: नारायणशरत्रस्तम् terrified by Narayana's arrows, शङ्खनादसुविह्वलम् overwhelmed by the blast of the conch, प्रभग्नम् broken, राक्षसम् बलम् the army of the rakshasas, लङ्काम् अभिमुखम् toward Lanka, ययौ went
entries.7.25: नारायणशराहते struck down by Narayana's arrows, राक्षसबले the army of the rakshasas, प्रभग्ने being broken, सुमाली Sumali, शरवर्षेण with a rain of arrows, रणे in the fight, हरिम् Hari, निववार held back
entries.7.26: सः तु he, तम् him, नीहारः mist, भास्करम् इव as the sun, छादयामास covered, सत्त्वसम्पन्नाः being brave, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, पुनः again, धैर्यम् heart, समादधुः took
entries.7.27: अथ then, बलदर्पितः proud of his strength, सः राक्षसः that rakshasa, रोषात् in fury, महानादम् a great roar, प्रकुर्वाणः uttering, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, जीवयन् इव as though giving life, अभ्यपतत् rushed forward
entries.7.28: लम्बाभरणम् his long ornaments, उत्क्षिप्य tossing, द्विपः an elephant, करम् इव as its trunk, धुन्वन् shaking, सः राक्षसः that rakshasa, हर्षात् for joy, सतडित्तोयदः यथा as a cloud lit with lightning, ररास roared
entries.7.29: नर्दतः as he roared, तस्य सुमालेः of that Sumali, यन्तुः of his charioteer, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् with its blazing earrings, शिरः the head, चिच्छेद he cut off, तस्य रक्षसः तु and of that rakshasa, अश्वाः च the horses, भ्रान्ताः ran wild
entries.7.30: भ्रान्तैः तैः अश्वैः by those maddened horses, सुमाली Sumali, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of rakshasas, धृतिहीनः without resolve, नरः a man, परिभ्रान्तैः इन्द्रियाश्वैः यथा as by the runaway horses of his senses, भ्राम्यते was whirled about
entries.7.31: ततः then, सुमालेः of Sumali, अश्वैः by the horses, रथे the chariot, हृते having been carried off, विष्णुरथम् प्रति toward Vishnu's chariot, रणाजिरे upon the field of battle, प्रपतन्तम् bearing down, महाबाहुम् the mighty armed, विष्णुम् Vishnu
entries.7.32: माली च and Mali, युक्तः made ready, सशरम् with its arrows, धनुः his bow, प्रगृह्य having taken up, अभ्यद्रवत् came on, मालेः धनुश्च्युताः loosed from Mali's bow, कार्तस्वरविभूषिताः adorned with gold, बाणाः the arrows, हरिम् Hari, आसाद्य having reached, पत्ररथाः birds, क्रौञ्चम् इव as the Krauncha mountain, विविशुः entered
entries.7.33: अथ then, मालिमुक्तैः loosed by Mali, सहस्रशः by thousands, शरैः by arrows, अर्द्यमानः though tormented, सः विष्णुः that Vishnu, रणे in the battle, जितेन्द्रियः one who has conquered his senses, अधिभिः इव as by afflictions, न चुक्षुभे was not shaken
entries.7.34: अथ then, भगवान् the lord, भूतभावनः the maker of beings, अरिनिषूदनः the destroyer of foes, मौर्वीस्वनम् the sound of his bowstring, कृत्वा having made, मालिनम् प्रति at Mali, बाणौघान् floods of arrows, ससर्ज loosed
entries.7.35: वज्रविद्युत्प्रभाः bright as the thunderbolt and the lightning, ते शराः those arrows, मालिदेहम् Mali's body, आसाद्य having reached, तस्य his, रुधिरम् blood, नागाः serpents, सुधारसम् इव as nectar, पिबन्ति drink
entries.7.36: शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः the bearer of conch and discus and mace, मालिनम् Mali, विमुखम् turned back, कृत्वा having made, मालिमौलिम् Mali's crown, ध्वजम् his banner, चापम् his bow, वाजिनः च अपि and his horses, अपातयत् struck down
entries.7.37: विरथः तु deprived of his chariot, माली Mali, नक्तञ्चरोत्तमः best of the night rangers, गदाम् his mace, गृह्य having taken up, गदापाणिः mace in hand, केसरी a lion, गिर्यग्रात् इव as from a mountain peak, आपुप्लुवे sprang forward
entries.7.38: गदया with the mace, अन्तकः Antaka, ईशानम् इव as Ishana, इन्द्रः Indra, वज्रेण with the thunderbolt, अचलम् यथा as a mountain, गरुडेशानम् the lord of Garuda, ललाटदेशे upon the forehead, अभ्यहनत् struck
entries.7.39: तेन मालिना by that Mali, गदया with the mace, भृशम् hard, अभिहतः struck, गरुडः Garuda, वेदनातुरः overcome with pain, देवम् the god, रणात् from the battle, पराङ्मुखम् with face turned aside, कृतवान् carried
entries.7.40: मालिना by Mali, गरुडेन वै through Garuda, देवे the god, पराङ्मुखे turned aside, कृते having been made, अभिनर्दताम् roaring in triumph, रक्षसाम् of the rakshasas, महान् शब्दः a great cry, उदतिष्ठत् arose
entries.7.41: रवताम् रक्षसाम् of the rakshasas as they roared, रावम् the shouting, श्रुत्वा having heard, हरिहयानुजः the younger brother of Indra
entries.7.42: भगवान् हरिः the lord Hari, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly angered, पक्षीशे upon the king of birds, तिर्यक् sideways, आस्थाय holding himself, पराङ्मुखः अपि though turned away, जिघांसया to slay him, मालेः at Mali, चक्रम् his discus, उत्ससर्ज loosed
entries.7.43: सूर्यमण्डलाभासम् bright as the disc of the sun, स्वभासा with its own radiance, नभः the sky, भासयन् lighting, कालचक्रनिभम् like the wheel of time, तत् चक्रम् that discus, मालेः Mali's, शीर्षम् head, अपातयत् struck down
entries.7.44: चक्रोत्कृत्तम् severed by the discus, बिभीषणम् dreadful, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of that lord of rakshasas, तत् शिरः that head, रुधिरोद्गारि pouring blood, पुरा of old, राहुशिरः यथा as Rahu's head, पपात fell
entries.7.45: ततः then, संहृष्टैः rejoicing, साधु देव इति वादिभिः crying Well done god, सुरैः by the gods, सर्वप्राणसमीरितः uttered with all their breath, सिंहनादरवः the roar of a lion's shout, उन्मुक्तः was let loose
entries.7.46: मालिनम् Mali, निहतम् slain, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सुमाली Sumali, माल्यवान् अपि and Malyavan too, सबलौ with their forces, शोकसन्तप्तौ burning with grief, लङ्काम् एव straight toward Lanka, प्रधावितौ fled
entries.7.47: गरुडः तु but Garuda, समाश्वस्तः recovered, यथा पुरा as before, सन्निवृत्य having turned back, कोपितः roused to anger, पक्षवातेन with the wind of his wings, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, द्रावयामास scattered
entries.7.48: चक्रकृत्तास्यकमलाः their lotus faces cut off by the discus, गदासञ्चूर्णितोरसः their chests crushed by the mace, लाङ्गलग्लपितग्रीवाः their necks broken by the plough weapon, मुसलैः by pestles, भिन्नमस्तकाः their heads split
entries.7.49: केचित् च एव some, असिना by the sword, छिन्नाः cut down, तथा and, अन्ये others, शरपीडिताः tormented by arrows, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, अम्बरात् from the sky, तूर्णम् swiftly, सागराम्भसि into the waters of the ocean, निपेतुः fell
entries.7.50: नारायणः Narayana, धनुर्विमुक्तैः loosed from his bow, बाणवराशनीभिः with the thunderbolts of his finest arrows, मुक्तविधूतकेशान् with their hair loosened and flying, नक्तञ्चरान् the night rangers, सतडिन्महाभ्राः great clouds with lightning, अशनीभिः यथा as with their bolts, विदारयामास tore apart
entries.7.51: भिन्नातपत्रम् its parasols broken, पतमानम् falling, अस्त्रम् its weapons, शरैः by arrows, अपध्वस्तविनीतवेषम् its trim array shattered, विनिस्सृतान्त्रम् its entrails spilled out, भयलोलनेत्रम् its eyes rolling with fear, तत् बलम् that army, उन्मत्ततरम् like a thing gone mad, बभूव became
entries.7.52: सिंहार्दितानाम् tormented by a lion, कुञ्जराणाम् इव as of elephants, कुञ्जराणाम् सह together with their elephants, निशाचराणाम् of those night rangers, पुराणसिंहेन by the ancient lion, विमर्दितानाम् as they were crushed, रवाः च the cries, वेगाः च and the rushing, समम् alike, बभूवुः were
entries.7.53: ते they, हरिबाणजालैः by the nets of Hari's arrows, वार्यमाणाः held back, सबाणजालानि their own nets of arrows, समुत्सृजन्तः loosing in return, नक्तञ्चरकालमेघाः those night rangers who were clouds of doom, वायुप्रभिन्नाः scattered by the wind, कालमेघाः इव as dark clouds, धावन्ति ran
entries.7.54: चक्रप्रहारैः by strokes of the discus, विनिकृत्तशीर्षाः their heads cut off, गदाप्रहारैः by blows of the mace, सञ्चूर्णिताङ्गाः च and their limbs crushed, अभिप्रहारैः by his onslaught, द्विविधाः in two ways, विभिन्नाः split apart, राक्षसेन्द्राः the lords of rakshasas, शैलाः इव as mountains, पतन्ति fell
entries.7.55: विलम्बमानैः swaying, मणिहारकुण्डलैः with their jewelled necklaces and earrings, नीलबलाहकोपमैः like dark rain clouds, निशाचरैः the night rangers, निपात्यमानैः as they were struck down, निरन्तरम् without pause, निपात्यमानैः as they were cast down, नीलपर्वतैः इव like dark mountains, ददृशे seemed
